skills.name: Locked Thread
skills.desc:
Basic Attack
Perform up to {0} consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG.
Hold Normal Attack right after Basic Attack Stage {1} to continuously attack the targets, dealing Spectro DMG. Hold this skill for a certain amount of time to cast Heavy Attack Stage {2}.
Hold Normal Attack shortly after Basic Attack Stage {3} lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage {4}.

Heavy Attack
Consume STA to lash out against the enemies with Monowire, dealing Spectro DMG.
Hold Normal Attack after Heavy Attack Stage {5} lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage {6}, dealing Spectro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting Heavy Attack Stage {7} to cast Basic Attack Stage {8}.

Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Spectro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage {9}.

Dodge Counter
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage {10}.
Hold Normal Attack shortly after this skill lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage {11}.

Basic Attack - Thread Shredding
When in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy's Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack - Thread Shredding.
Perform up to {12} consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.

Heavy Attack - Single Threading
When in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy's Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack - Single Threading.
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while airborne to cast Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while on the ground to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage {13}.

Heavy Attack - Dual Threading
When in Algorithm Compaction and Root Access reaches {14} points, Heavy Attack - Single Threading is replaced with Heavy Attack - Dual Threading.
Consume STA and all Root Access to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while airborne to cast Heavy Attack - Multi-threading.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while on the ground to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage {15}.

Heavy Attack - Multi-threading
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG and inflicting Hack - Shifting on the target. SQL can be consumed for a {16}% increase in this attack's DMG Multiplier.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage {17}.

Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction
When in Algorithm Compaction, Mid-air Attack is replaced with Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction.
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Spectro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage {18}.

Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction
When in Algorithm Compaction, Dodge Counter is replaced with Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage {19}.

skills.name: Protocol Breach
skills.desc:
Resonance Skill - Payload
Cast Resonance Skill - Payload to charge forward, dealing Spectro DMG and inflicting Hack - Shifting. Upon hitting the target, a follow-up attack is automatically triggered, dealing Spectro DMG and activating Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference. If no target is hit during the charge, reduce the skill CD by {0}%. If the charge is interrupted or not successfully cast, the skill CD is not reduced.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after the follow-up attack to cast Basic Attack Stage {1}.
Hold Normal Attack shortly after follow-up attack lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage {2}.

Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference
Cast Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference to cut through the target, dealing Spectro DMG and briefly Stagnating the target, before granting Digital Handshake. 
Digital Handshake: When Lucy is not in Algorithm Compaction and is the active Resonator in the team, she gains TCP every second. This effect is removed when TCP reaches {3} points or when Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive is cast.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage {4}.

Resonance Skill - Deadlock
When TCP reaches {5} points or Lucy is in Algorithm Compaction, Resonance Skill - Payload and Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference are replaced with Resonance Skill - Deadlock.
Cast Resonance Skill - Deadlock to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG and inflicting Hack - Shifting, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage {6}.
Reset the CD of Resonance Skill - Deadlock after casting Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive.

rows.name: Resonance Skill - Payload Follow-Up Attack DMG
Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference Concerto Regen

skills.name: Netrunner
skills.desc:
Resonance Liberation - Netrunner
Lucy deep dives into cyberspace and pulls up the Protocol Interface for {0}s. While the Protocol Interface is active, choose up to {1} different Spoofing Program effects, each requiring different RAM costs. Lucy starts with {2} {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=2} of RAM.
While in the Protocol Interface, Lucy marks targets within a certain range in her view. Marked targets will be applied with all Spoofing Program effects selected afterwards. Adjust Lucy's view to mark more targets. When no target is in view, no Spoofing Program can be applied.
While in the Protocol Interface, when either the duration expires or when Normal Attack is held down, Override is triggered, which deals Spectro DMG to all marked targets before closing the Protocol Interface, considered Heavy Attack DMG. When RAM runs out or is insufficient to activate any Spoofing Programs, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack to trigger Override on all marked targets. 
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

Spoofing Program: Ping
Requires {3} RAM. Extends field of view. Lucy marks and deals Spectro DMG to all nearby targets within the effective range without having to adjust the view, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Spoofing Program: Cyberware Malfunction
Requires {4} RAM. Marked targets take {5}% more DMG for {6}s.
Spoofing Program: Breach Protocol
Requires {7} RAM. Marked targets' DEF is reduced by {8}% for {9}s.
Spoofing Program: Synapse Burnout
Requires {10} RAM. Deals Spectro DMG to all marked targets within a certain range, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement
Requires {11} RAM. Deals Hack DMG to all marked targets and reduces their ATK by {12}% for {13}s.
Spoofing Program: Weapon Glitch
Requires {14} RAM. Causes all marked targets' attacks to have a chance to be reduced by {15}% within {16}s.
Spoofing Program: Cyberpsychosis
Requires {17} RAM. Convert all marked targets to neutral units and reduce their Vibration Strength. Only effective against Common Class enemies.

Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive
When in Algorithm Compaction, after Heavy Attack - Multi-threading is cast, Resonance Liberation - Netrunner is replaced with Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive. Lucy gains all effects of Resonance Liberation - Netrunner, and the DMG Multiplier of Override is greatly increased.
After casting Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive, or when Lucy exits the Algorithm Compaction state, Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive is replaced with Resonance Liberation - Netrunner.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

rows.name: Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive: Override DMG

skills.name: Outdated Hallucination
skills.desc:
Attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG and granting Resonators in the team Involuntary Sharing, allowing them to see targets behind obstacles for {0}s. Additionally, Involuntary Sharing is enhanced on Rebecca, allowing her to lock onto targets behind obstacles. If Rebecca's turret is on the field, its Overload effect is activated, increasing its DMG dealt for {1}s.
If Lucy is not in Algorithm Compaction after casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack within a certain time to cast Basic Attack Stage {2}.
If Lucy is in Algorithm Compaction after casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack within a certain time to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage {3}.
After casting this skill, the next Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference additionally grants {4} points of TCP.

skills.name: Depths of Blackwall
skills.desc:
Cloud Portal
When not in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy gains TCP upon hitting a target. At {0} points of TCP, Resonance Skill - Payload and Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference are replaced with Resonance Skill - Deadlock.
Casting Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive clears all TCP.

Algorithm Compaction
After casting Resonance Skill - Deadlock, Lucy enters Algorithm Compaction and gains {1} {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of SQL. Her Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack - Thread Shredding, and Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack - Single Threading. Lucy's Spectro DMG Bonus is increased by {2}% for {3}s.
While in Algorithm Compaction, casting Resonance Skill - Deadlock again will not grant SQL and Spectro DMG Bonus repetitively.
When in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy gains Root Access upon hitting a target with attacks including Basic Attack - Thread Shredding and Heavy Attack - Single Threading. Reaching {4} points of Root Access replaces Heavy Attack - Single Threading with Heavy Attack - Dual Threading. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting Heavy Attack - Dual Threading to cast Heavy Attack - Multi-threading.
When casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, if Lucy has SQL, increase this attack's DMG Multiplier by {5}% and remove SQL.
When casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, if Lucy does not have SQL, she loses {6}% of current HP. If Lucy's HP is below {7}%, no HP is consumed.
After casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, Resonance Liberation - Netrunner is replaced with Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive.
Lucy exits the the Algorithm Compaction state after casting Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive, or Heavy Attack - Multi-threading is not followed up by one of these skills: Normal Attack - Locked Thread, Resonance Skill - Protocol Breach, Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination, and Tune Break - Data Crash.

Hack Response - Data Crash
Lucy deals Spectro DMG to a target inflicted with Hack - Interfered and applies the same target with Data Crash, considered Hack DMG.
Data Crash: After the target deals damage, Stagnate the target for {9}s. Data Crash is removed after this effect is triggered.

TCP
Lucy holds up to {10} points of TCP.
Lucy gains TCP when she deals damage through Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Mid-air Attack, Dodge Counter.
Lucy gains TCP when she deals damage through Resonance Skill - Payload and Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference.
After casting Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination, casting the next Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference additionally grants {11} {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=A} of TCP.

Root Access
Lucy holds up to {12} points of Root Access.
Lucy gains Root Access when she deals damage through Basic Attack - Thread Shredding, Heavy Attack - Single Threading, Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction, and Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction.
